selection: Primary remains m30-n320-x160 from the prior frozen study regardless of these results. Development qualification is descriptive; never reselect after failure. Other candidates isolate removal of the full daily guard and fixed half/double entry/exit lookbacks. No candidate is promoted by ranking.

fixedRules.entry: Completed UTC 30m close >= prior N completed highs + one tick; exclude current candle. Long only, next minute open with adverse slippage and grid rounding. every-close reentry, no EMA/ADX/volume filter.
fixedRules.exit: Continuous minute initial stop at 2 times frozen signal Wilder ATR14. Completed close < prior M completed lows queues next-minute open exit. No ATR trailing, breakeven, fixed takeprofit or daily flatten. Cost, cooldown and per-sleeve daily guard can alter exits and entry eligibility.
fixedRules.dailyGuard: Each sleeve anchors equity at UTC day first mark.open before funding/orders; tests minute mark.close equity against 97% of anchor; after breach queue next minute open exit and block entry for remainder of UTC day. This is neither trade 3% nor intraday high-water drawdown nor portfolio guard. dailyLossPct=0 disables BOTH exit and daily entry lockout; cannot isolate these effects or UTC anchor sensitivity.
fixedRules.scales: 160/80,320/160,640/320 halve/double BOTH entry and exit horizons; all retain 30m Wilder14 stop ATR. Independently initialized 4/7/14 UTC-day warmups include a disclosed ATR seed difference; no ensemble capital/netting claim.
fixedRules.risk: Fixed 0.5% initial sleeve risk including stop fees/fill, exposure95%, 3 losses/60m cooldown, dailyLoss3% except single override0. Total60000 across six independent10000 sleeves, not shared cross-margin.
fixedRules.costs: Each side base5bps fee+2bps slippage; stress10+4. Actual funding. Four base candidates on development, four base plus four stress on every other window.
fixedRules.attribution: Each contrast replays the entire account, including alternative entry availability, risk state, quantity, fees and funding; no identical-entry or exit-classification causal claim.

mechanismEvaluation.method: Descriptive only. Paired circular calendar blocks sampled separately within each original window, preserving its length and sharing indices across candidate/primary/base/stress; percentile95% intervals for absolute and candidate-minus-primary daily means. Pool by day count, never chain NAV. Both block sizes always reported. No selection or multiplicity-adjusted significance claim; recent group remains already-known history.

acceptance: No new statistical promotion this round. Historical-completion comprises92days, below the prior180day evidence minimum even before trade counts/intervals; report evidence insufficient without weakening that gate. Fixed primary unchanged. Report every loss and both-cost result for all four accounts. Guard improvement is uncertain if either7/28day paired interval crosses0; do not replace the primary from point estimates. Neighboring horizons are stability diagnostics, not a search for a new winner. A positive historical expectation is distinct from effective prospective trading.
limitations: Repeated adaptive research on familiar surviving crypto markets; no untouched chronological OOS claim. Three completion months may overlap previously seen warmup observations.
Static modern lot/minNotional constraints and constant fee/slippage cannot reconstruct historical microstructure; no liquidation/order-book model.
Separated windows reset capital/risk/position; boundary forced exits may materially affect short windows. Daily portfolio drawdown excludes within-day peak/trough.
Nonstationarity, strongly correlated symbols, return concentration and project-wide multiple trials are not removed by block bootstrap. 28day blocks on30/31day windows provide limited information.
No ensemble unless actual per-scale capital replays account for min lot/notional; no UTC anchor-hour optimization, grid or later rescoring this round.
No live or prospective data collection is running; any future observation protocol must use data unavailable when frozen and retain signal/order receive timestamps and execution assumptions.
